verdict.rationale: Casium's own pages repeatedly describe a client-facing platform that shows case status and next steps. It says one platform "shows you exactly where every case stands," offers "what's coming next," a "clear task list," a "guided checklist" with "clear deadlines," and "every step in one place." A live portal sign-in (portal.casium.com) confirms the surface exists. missing for 10: in-depth product documentation or screenshots of the dashboard's status/next-step views, independent or hands-on corroboration of how the portal actually works.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see where my case is — a client portal or dashboard with case status and next steps is a documented part of the product
